data.summary: Start deploying the project to an environment; the deployment runs on a worker and is followed with deploy status
data.effectNote: queues one deployment on the deploy worker; a repeat with the same --operation and arguments returns the deployment it started

operands.name: environment
operands.help: The environment to deploy to (staging, production)

options.name: operation
options.help: A key you choose that names this request; repeating it with the same arguments starts nothing new
